title: (PDF) Potential Anticancer Properties and Mechanisms of Action of Curcumin
abstract:
By integrating lysozyme’s antimicrobial and anti‐inflammatory effects with curcumin’s anticancer properties, the HA‐based nano‐platform offers a synergistic, dual‐functional strategy for osteosarcoma treatment with improved safety and bone‐healing potential.
Recent data advocate that ER stress and autophagy may as well play a role in the apoptosis process, which is induced by the curcumin analogue B19 in an epithelial ovarian tumor cell line and that autophagy inhibition could increase curcumin analogue-induced apoptosis by inducing severe ER stress. The ability of curcumin to induce apoptosis in tumor cells and its anti-angiogenic potential will be discussed in this review. Copyright© 2015 International Institute of Anticancer Research (Dr.
